name: – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Commission Delegated Regulation of 30 September 2024 amending Regulation (EU) 2019/1241 as regards measures to reduce incidental catches of common dolphin (Delphinus delphis) and other small cetaceans in the Bay of Biscay
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking to block a new EU rule that would restrict fishing in the Bay of Biscay to stop dolphins being caught in nets by accident. The Parliament says the dolphin catch data is incomplete and not transparent, and that the ban has badly hurt fishing businesses. It wants the rule stopped and the data checked independently before any such measures apply.

- The rule would ban fishing in parts of the Bay of Biscay to protect dolphins; Parliament wants it stopped.
- It affects French and Spanish fishing vessels and the coastal communities and auctions that depend on them.
- The rule cannot enter into force if the Commission accepts the objection; otherwise the dispute continues.
